title: A counterexample to Ryser's covering conjecture
summary: For every sufficiently large prime $`s\equiv2\pmod3`$ and every sufficiently large odd integer n , with the threshold depending on s , we construct an intersecting $`(s^n+1)`$-partite $`(s^n+1)`$-uniform hypergraph with covering number $`s^n+1`$. This disproves Ryser's covering conjecture in its intersecting case.

review.reason: Constructs intersecting hypergraphs disproving Ryser's covering conjecture for large parameters.
